name: browser
description: Persistent human-authenticated browser sessions — log into a site once by hand, then let deterministic adapters operate it. Never solves a security challenge; it stops and asks you.

verbs.name: browser
verbs.summary: log into a site once, then let adapters operate it

setup.hint: browser needs a root-created profile store that 5dive will not create behind your back, and a Chrome on the box.
